# Naman Chawla

> AI/ML Engineer at Coding Blocks in New Delhi, India. Builds AI products end-to-end on top of large language and generative models: agents, assistants, voice and video AI, and the deployment and GPU infrastructure that runs them in production. Outside of work: research papers and side projects on reinforcement learning, quantization, and distillation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://palindromerice.github.io/): About Naman, with contact and social links
- [Writing](https://palindromerice.github.io/writing/): Articles, published research papers and LinkedIn posts
- [Projects](https://palindromerice.github.io/projects/): Personal ML projects with code

## Articles

- [I Keep Losing My TV Remote, So I Turned My Mac Into One](https://palindromerice.github.io/writing/lgtv-remote/): A Mac menu-bar remote for LG webOS TVs over the local network, 2026
- [Agent-Assisted Reconstruction of Quake II Gameplay Code](https://palindromerice.github.io/writing/quake2-reconstruction/): Coding agents rebuild Quake II's gameplay module from stripped binaries; 99.0% of testable functions match and the module is playable, 2026
- [Small Models as Agents: SFT and GRPO on a Browser Task](https://palindromerice.github.io/writing/browser-agent-sft-grpo/): Qwen3.5-0.8B goes from 16% to 84% success on a live browser task, 2026
- [CAPL: Context-Aware Preference Rules for Steering a Frozen LLM](https://palindromerice.github.io/writing/capl/): Context-scoped preference rules steer a frozen generator, 2026

## Projects

- [LG TV Remote for Mac](https://github.com/palindromeRice/lgtv-remote-reverse-engineer): Menu-bar remote for LG webOS TVs with a trackpad pointer and power-on from standby
- [CAPL](https://github.com/palindromeRice/capl): Context-aware preference rules for steering a frozen LLM
- [Quake II reconstruction](https://github.com/palindromeRice/quake2-llm-decompile): Agent-assisted reconstruction of Quake II gameplay code with a differential test harness
- [openEnvRL](https://github.com/palindromeRice/openEnvRL): SFT and GRPO for a small model acting in a live browser
- [Single-Bit Quantization of Transformers/BERT](https://github.com/palindromeRice/SingleBitLLMs): Benchmarks single-bit/ternary quantization strategies inspired by BitNet b1.58 on BERT
- [T5 Knowledge Distillation for Summarization](https://github.com/palindromeRice/Knowledge_Distillation_T5): Distills a fine-tuned T5-Base summarizer into T5-Small
- [Mixture-of-Experts Prompt Router](https://github.com/palindromeRice/Moe_demo): Routes prompts to specialized expert models via sentence-embedding similarity
